case.summary: This case was triggered when the cardholder reported that they did not make the flagged purchase and confirmed they still hold the card. Assuming the dispute was unprompted with no familiar-merchant match, decisive evidence showed the customer denied the transaction alongside an assessed fraud probability of 0.848. The verdict is fraud, and the actions to block the card and create a case follow Fraud Policy R2 because the customer denied the transaction.
